demo_plan.description: How this PBI is demonstrated LOCALLY at Sprint Review (commands/URL/steps; local substitutes for cloud-only parts). Set by backlog-refinement; update-backlog-status.sh refuses ->refined while empty for kind=code. kind=docs is exempt (the doc is the demo).

kind.description: PBI kind. 'docs' = paths_touched MUST be subset of *.md (machine-enforced at mark-pbi-ready-to-merge). 'docs' PBIs skip Design / UT / Coverage stages; impl + impl-reviewer only.

audit_identity.description: Cross-Sprint dedup key for codebase-audit PBIs: the stable defect-CLASS identity. Two lower-kebab parts, <defect-class>::<pattern>. Never a file path or a line number — both drift under refactoring and silently mint a new class, which is what makes the same defect resurface Sprint after Sprint. Required by add-backlog-item.sh whenever the title starts with '[codebase-audit:'.

audit_severity.description: Audit finding severity for codebase-audit PBIs — the CANONICAL value (the title's ':<Severity>]' suffix is a human-scannable snapshot taken at filing time). critical = a bug that prevents the spec from being met; high = the spec is met but leaving it unfixed causes future harm; low = an improvement that need not be fixed. Ordering: low < high < critical. Everything that is not 'low' blocks Integration-Sprint entry while open. Distinct from pbi-pipeline-envelope.schema.json's 4-value per-finding 'severity', which the Integrity/termination gates consume.
